components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Compact principal action for Publish, Done, and creation.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .12); transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--blueprint-blue-light)); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }

components.name: Compact Field
components.description: Dense field used by conditions, destinations, and question settings.
components.css: .ds-field-compact { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-field-compact:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--foreground) / .75); } .ds-field-compact:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Question and Logic Tabs
components.description: Peer modes for content editing and respondent-path editing.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--muted) / .25); } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font: 500 12px/1 var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-tab:hover { color: hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-tab-active { background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .08); } .ds-count { min-width: 16px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--primary) / .15); color: hsl(var(--primary)); font-size: 10px; }

components.description: Canvas summary for one canonical ordered question.

components.css: .ds-question-node { width: 256px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary)); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--primary)), 0 0 20px rgb(99 102 241 / .15); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-node-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border) / .6); color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 12px; } .ds-node-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 20px; height: 20px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 4px; background: hsl(var(--primary) / .15); color: hsl(var(--primary)); font-weight: 700; } .ds-node-body { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-answer-preview { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 12px; } .ds-question-node:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--primary)), 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / .10); } .ds-question-node:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Branch Rule Card
components.description: One priority-ordered branch with match mode, conditions, and destination.
components.html:
1Rule 1Priority 1
WhenMatch all

components.css: .ds-rule-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 12px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-rule-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background: hsl(var(--muted) / .25); font-size: 12px; } .ds-rule-header span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-rule-header small { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 10px; } .ds-rule-number { display: inline-flex; width: 24px; height: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rule-body { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-rule-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-segment { padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 4px; background: hsl(var(--background)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); } .ds-condition { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--muted) / .20); } .ds-condition small { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-destination { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--primary) / .08); color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-rule-card:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--primary) / .5); } .ds-rule-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Computed normal path shown after all explicit rules.

components.css: .ds-fallback { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--muted) / .20); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; } .ds-fallback span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-fallback small { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-fallback-arrow { color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 16px; } .ds-fallback:hover { background: hsl(var(--muted) / .35); } .ds-fallback:focus-within { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Blueprint's authenticated builder is an operational workspace: compact, ordered, and explicit. It uses paper-like surfaces, ink-colored structure, and blueprint blue for selection and action. The interface stays quiet enough for long authoring sessions while keeping the current question, save state, and routing decisions easy to scan.

The builder presents form logic in the language of questions and respondent paths. Question editing and Logic are separate modes in the properties panel. Logic is expressed as ordered rule cards rather than graph editing: priority is visible, conditions are stacked, the all/any relationship is explicit, every rule names its destination, and a computed otherwise card explains the normal path.
keyCharacteristics: Compact three-panel desktop workspace with a fixed top action bar.
Paper, ink, and blueprint-blue palette with low-contrast panel layering.
Small, direct labels and restrained iconography for dense authoring controls.
Canonical question order separated from movable canvas layout.
Branching shown as a readable priority list with an explicit fallback.
Dedicated ordered mobile question list below the desktop breakpoint.

rules.name: The Blue Means Action Rule
rules.body: Use blueprint blue for action, focus, selection, and active routing state; do not turn whole panels blue.

rules.name: The Ink Carries Structure Rule
rules.body: Text, borders, and connectors establish hierarchy before shadows or decoration do.

rules.name: The Small Is Still Legible Rule
rules.body: Ten-pixel text is reserved for short metadata; instructions and editable values remain at twelve pixels or larger.

rules.name: The Order Is Behavior Rule
rules.body: The question array is the canonical respondent order. Canvas coordinates only arrange the diagram and must never determine traversal, fallback, persistence order, or destination eligibility.

rules.name: The Forward Path Rule
rules.body: Rule destinations may only be later questions or form submission. Conditions may reference the current question or an earlier compatible choice or rating question.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep resting authoring surfaces nearly flat; use depth to communicate interaction state, not decoration.

dos: Do keep Question and Logic as separate, equally discoverable editing modes.
Do show rule priority as both order and a visible number, and renumber after every move or deletion.
Do say that rules run top to bottom and the first matching rule wins.
Do keep all/any selection adjacent to the condition list it governs.
Do show an explicit destination in every rule and a computed otherwise destination after the list.
Do derive sequential canvas edges and fallback behavior from canonical question array order.
Do preserve keyboard labels, focus rings, and text cues so color is never the only state signal.
donts: Don't infer respondent order from x/y canvas coordinates.
Don't allow a branch to target the same question, an earlier question, or an unknown node.
Don't hide priority in storage or connector geometry; it must be readable and directly reorderable.
Don't mix question-content fields into the Logic mode or branching controls into the Question mode.
Don't present the fallback as another editable rule; it is the computed normal path.
Don't bring the public site's exaggerated doodle borders and offset shadows into nested logic controls.
